stylePrefix: Original game art for Naija Street Life, a 2D Nigerian street-life game. STYLE: hand-painted gouache and watercolour texture with confident dark brown-black ink outlines, muted earthy slightly desaturated palette with warm accents, weathered and lived-in contemporary Lagos, soft painted shading lit from the top-left. Match the painting style, palette and line quality of the reference image if one is attached, but do NOT copy its composition.
styleSuffix: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border, no UI. No uniforms insignia, no badges with words, no real agency marks.

assets.name: chr-drivers-a
assets.prompt: A sprite sheet on a fully transparent background, a strict grid of 4 columns by 2 rows, EIGHT DIFFERENT full-body people, one per cell, each standing facing down toward the viewer, centred with empty gaps, same scale and feet baseline. Chunky charming proportions with large heads (about one third of body height), seen from a high top-down three-quarter camera, exactly like the people in the second reference image. Lagos DRIVERS, each looking annoyed with hands on hips or pointing: (1) a danfo bus driver in a sweaty white singlet and shorts with a towel over his shoulder, (2) a danfo conductor in a faded waistcoat holding folded cash, (3) a taxi driver in a striped polo shirt and flat cap, (4) a tired truck driver in blue overalls, (5) a man in a white office shirt, tie and trousers stepping out of his car, (6) a woman driver in a blouse, wrapper skirt and headwrap, holding car keys, (7) a keke tricycle driver in a short-sleeved shirt and a bucket hat, (8) an okada motorcycle rider in a reflective vest holding his red helmet. No ground, no shadows, no labels.
